# Raahtech Command Center

> AI-Assisted Enterprise Operations Platform integrating ServiceNow-style workflows with Microsoft enterprise environments and Azure AI intelligence.

Raahtech Command Center unifies IT operations, incident response, service request management, asset oversight, and AI-driven automation in a single console designed for enterprise SRE, security, and engineering teams.

## Pages

- [Operations Dashboard](/): Real-time view of service health, ops rhythm, and threat posture.
- [Incidents](/incidents): Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents across services.
- [Service Requests](/requests): Self-service catalog and request lifecycle tracking.
- [Assets](/assets): Inventory and posture for infrastructure and endpoints.
- [AI Copilot](/copilot): Conversational assistant for operations and investigations.
- [Digital Twin](/digital-twin): Live topology and dependency simulation.
- [AI Autopilot](/autopilot): Automated remediation policies and previews.
- [Root Causes](/root-causes): Cluster analysis of recurring failure signals.
